question: Does the frozen R10AL one-step planner keep making geometric progress from two declared exposed starts, or stall under optimistic exact-tracking assumptions?

starts: First nonterminal partial sample with all four ordinary positive-bearing feet.
First nonterminal partial sample with both rear feet positive-bearing and neither front foot positive-bearing.

propagation.stop_rule: First explicit no-selected-plan refusal, or all 600 updates.
propagation.state_update: Apply only mathematical virtual translation, normalized quaternion blend and joint targets. Recompute ideal FK endpoints, torso-local COM projection, horizontal heading and four-foot center.
propagation.fixed_quantities: Retain original positive-bearing and qualified masks, initial inferred floor and height goal, morphology, torso-local COM. No contact acquisition is simulated.
propagation.observations: Snapshot every 60 updates and at stop; record each chosen plan, torso-up direction, goal gap, minimum nonbearing modeled cap clearance and anchored endpoint drift.
limitations: Exact virtual torso and joint tracking is assumed, not predicted.
A free endpoint crossing the floor remains a modeled penetration; never convert it into contact or support.
No contact forces, friction, collision response, actuator tracking or new native observations.
No controller selection, world launch, deadline relaxation or physical success claim.
